ck_contact_channel_address__approved_by.name: ck_contact_channel_address__approved_by
ck_contact_channel_address__approved_by.value: "cera"."contact_channel_address"."relationship_status" <> 'APPROVED' OR ("cera"."contact_channel_address"."approved_by_actor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."contact_channel_address"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_comm_message__outbound_recipient_cont.name: ck_comm_message__outbound_recipient_content
ck_comm_message__outbound_recipient_cont.value: "cera"."comm_message"."direction" <> 'OUTBOUND' OR ("cera"."comm_message"."to_address_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."comm_message"."message_content_ref" IS NOT NULL)

ck_message_approval__approved_copy.name: ck_message_approval__approved_copy
ck_message_approval__approved_copy.value: "cera"."message_approval"."decision" <> 'APPROVED' OR ("cera"."message_approval"."approved_content_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."message_approval"."approved_to_address_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_message_approval__reason_required.name: ck_message_approval__reason_required
ck_message_approval__reason_required.value: "cera"."message_approval"."decision" NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'REVISION_REQUESTED') OR "cera"."message_approval"."reason" IS NOT NULL

ck_event__class_observation.name: ck_event__class_observation
ck_event__class_observation.value: "cera"."event"."event_class" <> 'OBSERVATION' OR ("cera"."event"."fact_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."event"."fact_key" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("cera"."event"."value_text", "cera"."event"."value_number", "cera"."event"."value_timestamp", "cera"."event"."value_code") >= 1 AND "cera"."event"."supersedes_event_id" IS NULL AND "cera"."event"."verification_action" IS NULL AND "cera"."event"."verification_method" IS NULL)

ck_event__class_correction.name: ck_event__class_correction
ck_event__class_correction.value: "cera"."event"."event_class" <> 'CORRECTION' OR ("cera"."event"."fact_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."event"."fact_key" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."event"."supersedes_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."event"."verification_action" IS NULL AND "cera"."event"."verification_method" IS NULL)

ck_event__class_verification.name: ck_event__class_verification
ck_event__class_verification.value: "cera"."event"."event_class" <> 'VERIFICATION' OR ("cera"."event"."fact_kind" IS NULL AND "cera"."event"."fact_key" IS NULL AND num_nonnulls("cera"."event"."value_text", "cera"."event"."value_number", "cera"."event"."value_timestamp", "cera"."event"."value_code") = 0 AND "cera"."event"."supersedes_event_id" IS NULL AND "cera"."event"."verification_action" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."event"."verification_method" IS NOT NULL)

ck_event__valid_range.name: ck_event__valid_range
ck_event__valid_range.value: "cera"."event"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "cera"."event"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "cera"."event"."valid_from" < "cera"."event"."valid_until"

ck_extraction__reviewed_at.name: ck_extraction__reviewed_at
ck_extraction__reviewed_at.value: "cera"."extraction"."review_status" NOT IN ('ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED') OR "cera"."extraction"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL

ck_extraction__pending_unreviewed.name: ck_extraction__pending_unreviewed
ck_extraction__pending_unreviewed.value: "cera"."extraction"."review_status" <> 'PENDING' OR ("cera"."extraction"."reviewed_by_actor_id" IS NULL AND "cera"."extraction"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "cera"."extraction"."created_event_id" IS NULL)

ck_canonical_fact__valid_range.name: ck_canonical_fact__valid_range
ck_canonical_fact__valid_range.value: "cera"."canonical_fact"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "cera"."canonical_fact"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "cera"."canonical_fact"."valid_from" < "cera"."canonical_fact"."valid_until"

ck_recovery_plan__amounts.name: ck_recovery_plan__amounts
ck_recovery_plan__amounts.value: ("cera"."recovery_plan"."objective_krw" IS NULL OR "cera"."recovery_plan"."objective_krw" >= 0) AND ("cera"."recovery_plan"."base_cost_krw" IS NULL OR "cera"."recovery_plan"."base_cost_krw" >= 0) AND ("cera"."recovery_plan"."risk_penalty_krw" IS NULL OR "cera"."recovery_plan"."risk_penalty_krw" >= 0) AND "cera"."recovery_plan"."baseline_total_krw" >= 0 AND "cera"."recovery_plan"."baseline_base_cost_krw" >= 0

ck_recovery_plan__infeasible_status.name: ck_recovery_plan__infeasible_status
ck_recovery_plan__infeasible_status.value: ("cera"."recovery_plan"."plan_status" <> 'INFEASIBLE' OR "cera"."recovery_plan"."objective_krw" IS NULL) AND ("cera"."recovery_plan"."plan_status" NOT IN ('PROPOSED', 'APPROVED') OR "cera"."recovery_plan"."objective_krw" IS NOT NULL)

ck_facility_planning_profile__hours.name: ck_facility_planning_profile__hours
ck_facility_planning_profile__hours.value: "cera"."facility_planning_profile"."open_from_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "cera"."facility_planning_profile"."last_departure_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "cera"."facility_planning_profile"."last_departure_hour" >= "cera"."facility_planning_profile"."open_from_hour"

ck_contact_selection__scope.name: ck_contact_selection__scope
ck_contact_selection__scope.value: ("cera"."contact_selection"."scope_type" = 'AGENT_RUN' AND "cera"."contact_selection"."agent_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."contact_selection"."plan_id" IS NULL AND "cera"."contact_selection"."action_key" IS NULL) OR ("cera"."contact_selection"."scope_type" = 'PLAN_FOLLOW_UP' AND "cera"."contact_selection"."plan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."contact_selection"."action_key" IS NOT NULL AND "cera"."contact_selection"."agent_run_id" IS NULL)
